name: Aly Orady
current_role: Founder of Tonal (CEO 2015-2023, then CTO; one profile lists him as founder/board member & advisor since Jan 2025)
profile: Engineer (McMaster computer engineering; Samsung, Sun, HP and enterprise startups) who founded Tonal, the electromagnetic-resistance smart home gym, in 2015. He led it as CEO until 2023, when it raised $130M and he moved to CTO; Tonal later appointed new CEOs (Todd Bartee named CEO in 2026).
interesting_fact: Tonal was born of his own health turnaround: after developing type 2 diabetes and sleep apnea he lost 70 pounds in nine months in 2014, then in March 2015 looked at a gym cable machine and wondered if electricity could replace its weight plates.
deep_cut_fact: He built the first Tonal prototypes himself on a wooden workbench at home with parts ordered online; the first version used a single magnet and gave only 25-40 lb of usable resistance, and he had studied electromagnetics at university but never built such a device in his jobs.
notes: Current exact title unclear (Tonal site: Founder & CTO; Village.ai: board member & advisor from 2025). Press route: media@tonal.com.

name: Isaac Oates
profile: Former Amazon engineer/product manager and Army officer who founded ad startup Adtuitive (sold to Etsy in 2009), then founded Justworks in 2012 to fix the payroll/HR pain he had at small companies. He handed the CEO role to Michael Seckler in Nov 2022 and, as Executive Chair, leads the board and focuses on Justworks Labs, Justworks.org and its Leaders' Fellowship.
interesting_fact: He enlisted in the Army Reserve at 17 with a parent's note and served 12 years, doing counterterrorism analysis on weekends while working full time; he even took a six-month leave from Amazon for officer training.
deep_cut_fact: His first startup, Adtuitive, was a five-person ad platform he founded after leaving Amazon in 2008; Etsy acquired it in 2009, and the HR/payroll headaches he saw there inspired Justworks.

name: Vishal Chaudhary
current_role: Co-founder and MD, Aerospace & Defence vertical, Zetwerk (IPO-bound, filed with SEBI in 2026)
profile: IIT Kharagpur dual-degree chemical engineer who worked at ITC and logistics startup Rivigo before co-founding Zetwerk in 2018, the Bengaluru-based manufacturing/contract-manufacturing platform. He long ran its industrial vertical and, in Zetwerk's 2026 pre-IPO reorganisation, now heads aerospace & defence.
interesting_fact: He helped Zetwerk win an order to supply 10,000 MT of fabricated steel girders for India's bullet-train project; Fortune India named him and co-founder Srinath Ramakkrushnan to its 40 Under 40 in 2023.
deep_cut_fact: Zetwerk's co-founders keep Saturday mornings reserved for brainstorming about the company's future, and he and Srinath share the motto 'What is good for the company trumps all views.'
notes: Role per Zetwerk UDRHP coverage (https://inc42.com/buzz/zetwerk-udrhp-a-look-at-shareholding-pattern-key-executives/). Company is in IPO quiet period, which may limit media availability.
